incidents.name: DEPUSDT proxy unprotected approval
incidents.notes: The DEPUSDT vault proxy exposed an approval/authorisation entry point with no access control, so the attacker granted itself an allowance over the vault's USDT and transferred the deposits out.

sources.ref: onchain review: proxy 0x7b190a928aa76eece5cb3e0f6b3bdb24fcdd9b4f created 2023-05-20T12:03:23Z by 0x83bd7b62301c36824718772181cad8b8180a82f3, unrelated to the attack sender; a single EIP-1967 Upgraded event in the creation block installs 0x94290106d2a32bc89be9f1c3a3f3394f64578aa6 and no later upgrade precedes the incident, so age runs from that install. The sibling LEVUSDC proxy 0x2a2b195558cf89aa617979ce28880bbf7e17bc45 lost a further ~$36K in tx 0x800a5b3178f680feebb81af69bd3dff791b886d4ce31615e601f2bb1f543bb2e; only the DEPUSDT leg is recorded here. Loss is USD-pegged stablecoins at 1:1.
